title: Cisco AI Defense Threat Operations
description:
Monitor Cisco AI Defense enforcement activity, risky prompts and responses, sensitive data detections, application and model activity, and related security detections.

This dashboard uses the `cisco_ai_defense` macro to find Cisco AI Defense events; configure it for your index, source, and sourcetype before use.

options.query:
`cisco_ai_defense`
| spath path="genai_application.application_name" output=Application
| where isnotnull(application_id) AND application_id!=""
| eval Application=if(isnull(Application) OR len(trim(Application))=0,application_id,Application)
| stats count as event_count values(Application) as application_names by application_id
| eval Application=mvjoin(application_names," / ")
| table Application application_id event_count
| sort 0 Application
`cisco_ai_defense` | search model.model_name!="" | stats count as event_count by model.model_name | rename model.model_name as model_name | table model_name event_count | sort 0 model_name

ds_ai_events_base.name: Cisco AI Defense normalized event base

options.query:
`cisco_ai_defense`
| where (application_id IN ($application_tok|s$) OR "*" IN ($application_tok|s$))
    AND ('model.model_name' IN ($model_tok|s$) OR "*" IN ($model_tok|s$))
| eval action=lower(event_action), direction=lower(event_message_type)
| spath path="genai_application.application_name" output=application_name
| spath path="connection.connection_name" output=connection_name
| spath path="policy.policy_name" output=policy_name
| spath path="event_policy_guardrail_assocs{}.policy_guardrail_assoc.guardrail_avail_ruleset.guardrail_ruleset_type" output=guardrails
| spath path="event_policy_guardrail_assocs{}.policy_guardrail_assoc.guardrail_avail_ruleset.guardrail.guardrails_type" output=guardrail_categories
| spath path="event_policy_guardrail_assocs{}.policy_guardrail_assoc.guardrail_avail_entity.guardrail_entity_name" output=entities
| spath path="event_messages{}.event_conversation.event_messages{}.metadata{}.standards{}" output=standards
| eval application_name=if(isnull(application_name) OR len(trim(application_name))=0,if(isnull(application_id) OR application_id="","Unknown application",application_id),application_name), connection_name=if(isnull(connection_name) OR len(trim(connection_name))=0,if(isnull(connection_id) OR connection_id="","Unknown connection",connection_id),connection_name), model_name=if(isnull('model.model_name') OR len(trim('model.model_name'))=0,"Unknown model",'model.model_name'), policy_name=if(isnull(policy_name) OR len(trim(policy_name))=0,"Unknown policy",policy_name)
| fields _time event_id application_id application_name connection_id connection_name model_name policy_name action direction resource_type guardrails guardrail_categories entities standards
| stats dc(event_id) as count
| stats dc(eval(if(action="block",event_id,null()))) as count

| eval is_highrisk=if(mvfind(guardrails,"(?i)prompt injection|code detection|\bPII\b|personally identifiable information|\bPCI\b|payment card industry")>=0,1,0)
| stats dc(eval(if(action="allow" AND is_highrisk=1,event_id,null()))) as count

| eval is_privacy=if(mvfind(guardrails,"(?i)\bPII\b|personally identifiable information|\bPCI\b|payment card industry")>=0,1,0)
| stats dc(eval(if(action="allow" AND direction="response" AND is_privacy=1,event_id,null()))) as count
| stats dc(eval(if(action="redact",event_id,null()))) as count
| timechart span=1h dc(event_id) as events by action

| where mvfind(guardrails,"(?i)\bPII\b|personally identifiable information|\bPCI\b|payment card industry")>=0
| mvexpand entities
| where isnotnull(entities) AND len(trim(entities))>0
| chart dc(event_id) over entities by action
| fillnull value=0

| where mvfind(guardrails,"(?i)\bPII\b|personally identifiable information|\bPCI\b|payment card industry")>=0
| eval rulesets=mvjoin(guardrails,", "), detected_entities=mvjoin(entities,", ")
| sort 0 - _time
| table _time action direction application_name application_id connection_name model_name policy_name rulesets detected_entities event_id
| head 100

| stats dc(event_id) as events values(action) as actions values(model_name) as models by application_name application_id
| eval actions=mvjoin(mvsort(actions),", "), models=mvjoin(mvsort(models),", ")
| sort 0 - events
| head 15
| rename application_name as Application application_id as "Application ID" events as Events actions as Actions models as "Models observed"
| table Application "Application ID" Events Actions "Models observed"

ds_models_by_action.name: Observed events by model and action

options.query:
| stats dc(event_id) as events by model_name action
| chart max(events) over model_name by action
| fillnull value=0

| makeresults
| eval detection_name=split("Cisco AI Defense Security Alerts by Application Name|Cisco AI Defense Repeated High Risk Activity|Cisco AI Defense Allowed Sensitive Response|Cisco AI Defense Allowed Sensitive Prompt","|")
| mvexpand detection_name
| eval expected_savedsearch="ESCU - ".detection_name." - Rule", ai_system="Cisco AI Defense", mapped=1, data_sources="Cisco AI Defense Alerts"
| fields ai_system detection_name expected_savedsearch mapped data_sources
| append
    [ | rest /servicesNS/-/-/saved/searches splunk_server=local
      | where title IN ("ESCU - Cisco AI Defense Security Alerts by Application Name - Rule","ESCU - Cisco AI Defense Repeated High Risk Activity - Rule","ESCU - Cisco AI Defense Allowed Sensitive Response - Rule","ESCU - Cisco AI Defense Allowed Sensitive Prompt - Rule")
      | rename title as expected_savedsearch
      | eval savedsearch_present=1
      | eval enabled=if(disabled==0 OR disabled=="0","Enabled","Disabled")
      | eval scheduled=if(is_scheduled==1 OR is_scheduled=="1","Scheduled","Not scheduled")
      | eval finding_output=case(match(actions,"(^|,)risk(,|$)") OR 'action.risk'==1 OR 'action.risk'=="1","Risk", match(actions,"(^|,)notable(,|$)") OR 'action.notable'==1 OR 'action.notable'=="1","Notable", true(),"No risk/notable")
      | eval schedule=coalesce(cron_schedule,""), window=coalesce('dispatch.earliest_time',"")." to ".coalesce('dispatch.latest_time',""), app_name=coalesce('eai:acl.app','eai:appName',"")
      | fields expected_savedsearch savedsearch_present enabled scheduled finding_output schedule window app_name ]
| stats max(mapped) as mapped values(ai_system) as ai_system values(data_sources) as data_sources values(detection_name) as detection_name max(savedsearch_present) as savedsearch_present values(enabled) as enabled values(scheduled) as scheduled values(finding_output) as finding_output values(schedule) as schedule values(window) as window values(app_name) as app_name by expected_savedsearch
| where mapped==1
| eval present=if(savedsearch_present==1,"Present","Missing")
| eval enabled=coalesce(mvindex(enabled,0),"Missing"), scheduled=coalesce(mvindex(scheduled,0),"Missing"), finding_output=coalesce(mvindex(finding_output,0),"Missing")
| eval readiness=case(present=="Missing","Missing saved search",enabled!="Enabled","Disabled",scheduled!="Scheduled","Not scheduled",finding_output=="No risk/notable","No risk/notable action",true(),"Ready")
| eval data_sources=mvjoin(mvsort(data_sources),", "), schedule=coalesce(mvindex(schedule,0),""), window=coalesce(mvindex(window,0),""), app_name=coalesce(mvindex(app_name,0),"")
| sort readiness detection_name
| rename detection_name as Detection expected_savedsearch as "Saved Search" readiness as Readiness finding_output as "Finding Output" schedule as Schedule window as Window app_name as App data_sources as "Data Sources"
| table Detection "Saved Search" Readiness "Finding Output" Schedule Window App "Data Sources"

ds_live_ai_findings_base.name: Cisco AI Defense ESCU risk and notable results

options.query:
search (index=risk OR index=notable)
    [ | makeresults
      | eval savedsearch_title=mvappend("ESCU - Cisco AI Defense Security Alerts by Application Name - Rule", "ESCU - Cisco AI Defense Repeated High Risk Activity - Rule", "ESCU - Cisco AI Defense Allowed Sensitive Response - Rule", "ESCU - Cisco AI Defense Allowed Sensitive Prompt - Rule")
      | mvexpand savedsearch_title
      | stats values(savedsearch_title) as savedsearch_title dc(savedsearch_title) as savedsearch_count
      | eval quoted="\"".mvjoin(savedsearch_title,"\",\"")."\""
      | eval search=if(savedsearch_count>0,"(source IN (".quoted.") OR search_name IN (".quoted.") OR savedsearch_name IN (".quoted.") OR orig_source IN (".quoted.") OR rule_name IN (".quoted."))","source=\"__cisco_ai_defense_no_match__\"")
      | return $search ]
| eval finding_source=case(index="risk","Risk event",index="notable","Notable",true(),index)
| eval savedsearch_title=coalesce(if(match(search_name,"^ESCU - Cisco AI Defense .+ - Rule$"),search_name,null()),if(match(source,"^ESCU - Cisco AI Defense .+ - Rule$"),source,null()),if(match(savedsearch_name,"^ESCU - Cisco AI Defense .+ - Rule$"),savedsearch_name,null()),if(match(orig_source,"^ESCU - Cisco AI Defense .+ - Rule$"),orig_source,null()),if(match(rule_name,"^ESCU - Cisco AI Defense .+ - Rule$"),rule_name,null()))
| where savedsearch_title IN ("ESCU - Cisco AI Defense Security Alerts by Application Name - Rule","ESCU - Cisco AI Defense Repeated High Risk Activity - Rule","ESCU - Cisco AI Defense Allowed Sensitive Response - Rule","ESCU - Cisco AI Defense Allowed Sensitive Prompt - Rule")
| eval detection=replace(replace(savedsearch_title,"^ESCU - ","")," - Rule$","")
| eval risk_numeric=tonumber(coalesce(calculated_risk_score,risk_score))
| eval severity=case(finding_source="Risk event",lower(coalesce(severity,case(risk_numeric>=80,"critical",risk_numeric>=50,"high",risk_numeric>=20,"medium",risk_numeric>0,"low",true(),"unknown"))),finding_source="Notable",lower(coalesce(severity,urgency,"unknown")),true(),lower(coalesce(severity,"unknown")))
| eval entity=case(finding_source="Risk event",coalesce(risk_object,normalized_risk_object,user,dest,src,host,"unknown"),finding_source="Notable",coalesce(risk_object,normalized_risk_object,user,dest,src,host,rule_name,"unknown"),true(),coalesce(risk_object,normalized_risk_object,user,dest,src,host,"unknown"))
| eval detail=case(finding_source="Risk event",coalesce(risk_message,source,search_name,detection,""),finding_source="Notable",coalesce(rule_description,description,rule_name,detection,""),true(),coalesce(risk_message,rule_description,source,detection,""))
| eval detail=substr(detail,1,500), event_key=coalesce(event_id,source_event_id,sid,_cd,tostring(_time)."|".savedsearch_title."|".entity."|".coalesce(detail,""))
| dedup event_key detection
| fields _time finding_source detection severity risk_numeric entity detail savedsearch_title

| stats count as Findings dc(entity) as Entities by detection finding_source
| appendpipe [ | stats count as result_count | where result_count==0 | eval detection="No matching detection results", finding_source="Status", Findings=0, Entities=0 | fields - result_count ]
| sort 0 - Findings

| timechart span=1d count by finding_source
| appendpipe [ | stats count as result_count | where result_count==0 | eval _time=now(), "No detection results"=0 | fields _time "No detection results" ]
| fillnull value=0

| eval eventTime=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| sort 0 -_time
| table eventTime finding_source severity detection entity risk_numeric detail
| appendpipe [ | stats count as result_count | where result_count==0 | eval eventTime="", finding_source="Status", severity="info", detection="No matching detection results", entity="No risk/notable events in selected time window", risk_numeric=0, detail="This table populates when one of the four Cisco AI Defense ESCU detections produces risk or notable output." | fields - result_count ]

| where mvfind(guardrails,"(?i)prompt injection|code detection|\bPII\b|personally identifiable information|\bPCI\b|payment card industry")>=0
| stats dc(eval(if(action="allow",event_id,null()))) as count

| where action="block" AND mvfind(guardrails,"(?i)prompt injection|code detection|\bPII\b|personally identifiable information|\bPCI\b|payment card industry")>=0
| stats dc(event_id) as count

| where action="allow" AND direction="response" AND mvfind(guardrails,"(?i)\bPII\b|personally identifiable information|\bPCI\b|payment card industry")>=0
| stats dc(event_id) as count

| where isnotnull(event_id) AND len(trim(event_id))>0 AND mvfind(guardrails,"(?i)prompt injection|code detection|\bPII\b|personally identifiable information|\bPCI\b|payment card industry")>=0
| bin _time span=10m
| stats count as Occurrences values(action) as Actions values(direction) as Directions values(guardrails) as Guardrails values(model_name) as Models by _time application_name application_id connection_name connection_id event_id
| where Occurrences>=3
| eval Window=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| rename application_name as Application connection_name as Connection event_id as "Event ID"
| table Window Application Connection "Event ID" Occurrences Actions Directions Guardrails Models
| sort 0 - Occurrences
| head 100

ds_attack_paths.name: Risky behavior by direction and policy outcome

options.query:
`cisco_ai_defense`
| where (application_id IN ($application_tok|s$) OR "*" IN ($application_tok|s$))
    AND ('model.model_name' IN ($model_tok|s$) OR "*" IN ($model_tok|s$))
| eval action=lower(event_action), direction=lower(event_message_type)
| spath path="genai_application.application_name" output=application_name
| spath path="connection.connection_name" output=connection_name
| spath path="policy.policy_name" output=policy_name
| spath path="event_policy_guardrail_assocs{}.policy_guardrail_assoc.guardrail_avail_ruleset.guardrail_ruleset_type" output=guardrails
| spath path="event_policy_guardrail_assocs{}.policy_guardrail_assoc.guardrail_avail_ruleset.guardrail.guardrails_type" output=guardrail_categories
| spath path="event_policy_guardrail_assocs{}.policy_guardrail_assoc.guardrail_avail_entity.guardrail_entity_name" output=entities
| spath path="event_messages{}.event_conversation.event_messages{}.metadata{}.standards{}" output=standards
| eval application_name=if(isnull(application_name) OR len(trim(application_name))=0,if(isnull(application_id) OR application_id="","Unknown application",application_id),application_name), connection_name=if(isnull(connection_name) OR len(trim(connection_name))=0,if(isnull(connection_id) OR connection_id="","Unknown connection",connection_id),connection_name), model_name=if(isnull('model.model_name') OR len(trim('model.model_name'))=0,"Unknown model",'model.model_name'), policy_name=if(isnull(policy_name) OR len(trim(policy_name))=0,"Unknown policy",policy_name)
| fields _time event_id application_id application_name connection_id connection_name model_name policy_name action direction resource_type guardrails guardrail_categories entities standards
| mvexpand guardrails
| eval attack_class=case(match(guardrails,"(?i)prompt injection"),"Prompt injection",match(guardrails,"(?i)code detection"),"Code generation or abuse",match(guardrails,"(?i)\bPII\b|personally identifiable information|\bPCI\b|payment card industry"),"Sensitive data (PII/PCI)",true(),null())
| where isnotnull(attack_class)
| eval attack_path=attack_class." / ".coalesce(direction,"unknown")
| stats dc(event_id) as events by attack_path action
| chart max(events) over attack_path by action
| fillnull value=0
| sort 0 attack_path

| where action="allow" AND mvfind(guardrails,"(?i)prompt injection|code detection|\bPII\b|personally identifiable information|\bPCI\b|payment card industry")>=0
| eval attack_class=case(mvfind(guardrails,"(?i)prompt injection")>=0,"Prompt injection",mvfind(guardrails,"(?i)code detection")>=0,"Code generation or abuse",mvfind(guardrails,"(?i)\bPII\b|personally identifiable information|\bPCI\b|payment card industry")>=0,"Sensitive data (PII/PCI)",true(),"Other high-risk")
| stats dc(event_id) as Events values(direction) as Directions values(guardrails) as Guardrails values(entities) as Entities values(policy_name) as Policies values(connection_name) as Connections by application_name application_id model_name attack_class
| eval Directions=mvjoin(Directions,", "), Guardrails=mvjoin(Guardrails,", "), Entities=mvjoin(Entities,", "), Policies=mvjoin(Policies,", "), Connections=mvjoin(Connections,", ")
| rename application_name as Application application_id as "Application ID" model_name as Model attack_class as "Attack class"
| sort 0 - Events
| head 100
| table Application "Application ID" Model "Attack class" Events Directions Guardrails Entities Policies Connections

options.markdown:
## Cisco AI Defense | Threat Overview
Runtime enforcement, allowed high-risk activity, and sensitive response signals. Use Application and Model filters to focus event telemetry.

viz_total_events.title: Events Observed
viz_total_events.description: Distinct Cisco AI Defense event IDs in the selected time range.

viz_blocked_events.title: Blocked Events
viz_blocked_events.description: Distinct events blocked by AI Defense.

viz_allowed_highrisk.title: Allowed High-Risk Events
viz_allowed_highrisk.description: Allowed events matching prompt-injection, code, PII, or PCI guardrails.

viz_allowed_sensitive_responses.title: Sensitive Responses Allowed
viz_allowed_sensitive_responses.description: Allowed responses matching PII or PCI privacy guardrails.

viz_repeat_window_count.title: Redacted Events
viz_repeat_window_count.description: Distinct events redacted by AI Defense in the selected time range.

viz_risk_timeline.title: Runtime Enforcement Over Time
viz_risk_timeline.description: Hourly volume by observed action. This includes all events, not only high-risk matches.

viz_sensitive_entities.title: Sensitive Entities by Action
viz_sensitive_entities.description: PII/PCI entity categories observed in events; message content is not shown.

viz_repeat_windows.title: Sensitive Match Review
viz_repeat_windows.description: Event-level PII/PCI matches with application, model, policy, and entity metadata. Prompt and response text is omitted.

viz_priority_queue.title: Recent ESCU AI Defense Findings
viz_priority_queue.description: Actual risk or notable records attributed to the four Cisco AI Defense ESCU detections. The empty state is informational, not a synthetic finding.

options.markdown:
## Attack Activity

### Prompt or Response → Guardrail Match → Policy Action

Compare risky behavior with enforcement outcomes, then review allowed paths and repeated event IDs. Counts describe observed events; the dashboard does not infer a successful compromise.

## Data Exposure
Review PII/PCI entities and affected applications, models, policies, and event direction. Payload text is intentionally excluded.

viz_apps_activity.title: Most Active Observed Applications
viz_apps_activity.description: Applications observed in Cisco AI Defense runtime events.

viz_models_activity.title: Observed Activity by Model and Action
viz_models_activity.description: Model names are taken from runtime events; unknown means the model field was not present.

viz_detection_readiness.title: Configured Detection Status
viz_detection_readiness.description: Shows whether each expected saved search is present, enabled, scheduled, and configured for risk/notable output. Requires saved-search REST visibility.

viz_findings_by_detection.title: Generated Findings by Detection and Source
viz_findings_by_detection.description: Risk and notable events attributed to the Cisco AI Defense detections.

viz_findings_over_time.title: Detection Output Over Time
viz_findings_over_time.description: Daily risk and notable events generated by these detections.

options.markdown:
## Application and Model Activity
Explore Cisco AI Defense runtime event volume across observed applications and models.

## Detection Coverage and Outcomes
Review configured Cisco AI Defense detections and the risk or notable events they generate.

viz_allowed_risk_count.title: Allowed High-Risk Events
viz_allowed_risk_count.description: Distinct allowed events matching prompt injection, code, PII, or PCI guardrails.

viz_blocked_risk_count.title: Blocked High-Risk Events
viz_blocked_risk_count.description: Distinct high-risk events blocked by AI Defense.

viz_allowed_sensitive_response_count.title: Sensitive Responses Allowed
viz_allowed_sensitive_response_count.description: Distinct allowed responses matching PII or PCI guardrails.

viz_attack_paths.title: Risky Behavior by Direction and Policy Outcome
viz_attack_paths.description: Distinct events classified from prompt-injection, code, and PII/PCI guardrails.

viz_allowed_risk_cases.title: Allowed High-Risk Paths Requiring Review
viz_allowed_risk_cases.description: Allowed events grouped by application, model, guardrail, and message direction. Message content is excluded.

viz_repeated_event_ids.title: Repeated High-Risk Event IDs
viz_repeated_event_ids.description: Event IDs with three or more high-risk occurrences in a ten-minute bucket, matching the repeated-activity detection threshold.
